description: This is an HTML file serving as the frontend interface for a database visualizer application. It includes structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript code to interact with a backend API for listing databases, tables, and viewing table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data from the API and resetting UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database and loads the tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a specific database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a specific table, rendering it in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cells, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expanded/collapsed display of cell content for long strings or objects.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message in a specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in a specified element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays a message indicating no data is available.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets the active state on a specified UI element.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch JSON data from specified API endpoints.
